title: Message envelope
description: Fields carried by every device message. Ordering is by (boot_id, seq); ts is data, never control.

schema.description: Schema identifier as name/major. A consumer that does not recognise the major must reject the message rather than guess.

device_id.description: Also present in the topic, duplicated so a payload is self-describing once detached from it.

site.description: Topic namespace segment. Broker ACLs and ingest partitioning are scoped by it.

boot_id.description: Changes on every device restart. Together with seq it forms the ordering key.

seq.description: Monotonic per boot_id across all streams from a device, starting at 1. Zero is reserved for the Last Will, which is composed before the device knows its final sequence number.

ts.description: Device-local clock, RFC 3339. Data only: device clocks drift and devices reboot without a real-time clock, so this is never used for ordering or latency.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context. MQTT 3.1.1 has no user properties, so it travels in the payload.
